info.title: Tellus Ontology Engine — Full API
info.description: Comprehensive API specification for the Tellus Ontology Engine. Covers ontology CRUD, object types, properties, link types, and action types.

tags.description: CRUD operations for object type definitions within an ontology

tags.description: CRUD operations for properties within an object type

tags.description: CRUD operations for link type definitions within an ontology

post.description: Creates a new ontology with the given display name and optional description.

409.description: Ontology with that name already exists

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all ontologies.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque token for fetching the next page of results

nextPageToken.description: Token for fetching the next page, or null if this is the last page

get.description: Returns the ontology identified by the given UUID.

put.description: Updates the display name and/or description of an existing ontology.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the ontology and all its child entities (object types, properties, link types, action types).

post.description: Creates an ontology and all its child entities from a JSON payload. Useful for migration or environment seeding.

schema.description: Full ontology export payload including object types, properties, link types, and action types

get.description: Returns the full ontology including all object types, properties, link types, and action types as a JSON document.

schema.description: Complete ontology payload including all child entities

post.description: Creates a new object type within the specified ontology.

icon.description: Icon identifier (e.g. an emoji or icon library key)

status.description: Lifecycle status of the object type

409.description: Object type with that apiName already exists

get.description: Returns all object types within the specified ontology.
Returns the object type identified by apiName within the given ontology.

put.description: Updates an existing object type's display name, description, icon, or status.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the object type and all its properties.

post.description: Creates a new property on the specified object type.

apiName.description: Unique programmatic name for the property

isArray.description: Whether the property holds an array of values

409.description: Property with that apiName already exists on this object type

get.description: Returns all properties for the specified object type.

put.description: Updates an existing property's display name, description, or other metadata.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the property from the object type.

post.description: Creates a new link type connecting two object types within the specified ontology.

apiName.description: Unique programmatic name for the link type

cardinality.description: Relationship cardinality between source and target object types

sourceObjectTypeApiName.description: apiName of the source object type

targetObjectTypeApiName.description: apiName of the target object type

description.description: Optional description of the link type

409.description: Link type with that apiName already exists

get.description: Returns all link types within the specified ontology.
Returns the link type identified by apiName within the given ontology.

put.description: Updates an existing link type's display name, description, or cardinality.

post.description: Registers a new action type definition in the specified ontology. The action type defines parameters, rules (side effects), and constraints for a reusable action.

apiName.description: Unique programmatic name for the action type

parameters.description: Map of parameter definitions keyed by parameter apiName

rules.description: Side-effect rules executed when the action runs

get.description: Returns all action types within the specified ontology.
Returns the action type identified by the given API name within the specified ontology.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the specified action type.

get.description: Returns the registered datasource for the specified object type.

post.description: Registers or updates the backing datasource for the specified object type.

columnMapping.description: Mapping of object type properties to dataset columns

get.description: Returns the current indexing status for the specified object type.

post.description: Triggers a full or incremental indexing of the specified object type into OpenSearch.

get.description: Returns all interfaces defined within the specified ontology.

post.description: Creates a new interface with typed property definitions within the specified ontology.

409.description: Interface with that apiName already exists

get.summary: Get edits for an object type
get.description: Returns a paginated list of edits applied to objects of the specified type via actions.
Resolves and returns linked objects for the specified link type.

parameters.name: primaryKey
parameters.description: Primary key of the source object

post.description: Searches for objects linked via the specified link type, with optional filtering and pagination.

primaryKey.description: Primary key of the source object

get.description: Returns the count of linked objects for the specified link type and primary key.

parameters.name: primaryKey
parameters.description: Primary key of the source object

post.description: Executes the specified action with the given parameters.

actionType.description: API name of the action type to execute

get.description: Returns the audit log entries for the specified action.
Searches object types, link types, and action types by name or apiName using a query string.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated resource types to search (objectType, linkType, actionType). Defaults to all.

get.description: Returns all starred/favorited resources for the current user.

post.description: Adds a resource to the user's favorites.

parameters.name: favoriteId
parameters.description: UUID of the favorite to remove

delete.description: Removes a resource from the user's favorites.

get.summary: List views for an object type
get.description: Returns all saved views (column configs, filters, sort orders) for the specified object type.

post.summary: Create a view for an object type
post.description: Creates a new saved view configuration for the specified object type.

columns.description: Ordered list of property apiNames to display

ObjectTypeApiName.description: Programmatic name of the object type

LinkTypeApiName.name: linkTypeApiName
LinkTypeApiName.description: Programmatic name of the link type
